backendStatusDefinitions.catalog-only: Backend has static catalog/sample knowledge only; no live inventory or apply path.
backendStatusDefinitions.missing: No equivalent backend capability exists yet.
backendStatusDefinitions.unsafe: Source action is destructive or security-sensitive and must not be implemented without a dedicated safety design.
backendStatusDefinitions.blocked: Capability cannot be safely mapped from source-only inspection, usually because Dash internals were not decompiled or third-party installers/binaries are opaque.

capabilities.title: Admin-gated playbook phase orchestration
capabilities.summary: main.yml requires Admin and chains prepare, strip, harden, gaming, apply, extended, and privacy task YAML files.
sourceEvidence: playbook.conf Requirements include DefenderToggled, NoPendingUpdates, NoAntivirus, Internet, PluggedIn, FreshInstall
capabilities.notes: Backend has no AME/playbook runner by design and should not run AME Wizard.

capabilities.title: VC++ redist, DirectX runtime, and browser installer bootstrap
capabilities.summary: Prepare phase installs VC++ redist, DirectX runtime assets, and optional Brave/Firefox/Chrome browser choices.
sourceEvidence: phase1-prepare.yml status messages Installing VC++ Redist, Installing DirectX Runtime, Installing Firefox, Installing Brave, Installing Chrome
capabilities.notes: Backend has no runtime/browser installer workflow.

capabilities.title: Balanced, AMD, and Intel power-plan import/selection
capabilities.summary: Feature page offers Balanced, AMD Gaming, and Intel Gaming plans; prepare/gaming phases import and activate power plans including bundled power-amd.pow.
capabilities.notes: High relevance to frame-time consistency, but no backend power-plan apply/restore contract exists yet.

capabilities.title: Appx deprovision/removal for bloat, AI, Store, and Xbox/Game Bar
capabilities.summary: Strip phase removes/deprovisions Microsoft consumer apps, Copilot/Recall-adjacent packages, Store, Xbox, and Game Bar packages.
sourceEvidence: phase2-strip.yml has 152 appx actions and 75 registryKey actions, mostly AppxAllUserStore Deprovisioned keys

rollbackOrBackupRules: New-CleanupDeletionManifest.ps1 emits preview-only backup requirements for files, registry exports, services, scheduled tasks, and startup entries.
backend/uninstall/uninstall-policy.json marks official uninstall and cleanup deletion as preview-only.

capabilities.notes: Current backend only previews uninstall/leftover metadata and intentionally does not execute Appx deprovision or removals.

capabilities.title: Edge, OneDrive, and WebView2 removal/cleanup scripts
capabilities.summary: Playbook bundles strip-edge.ps1, strip-onedrive.ps1, and remove-webview2.ps1 and wires them through selected strip/apply actions.
sourceEvidence: phase2-strip.yml statuses Removing Edge, Removing OneDrive, Disabling WebView2

rollbackOrBackupRules: New-CleanupDeletionManifest.ps1 emits preview-only backup requirements for files, registry exports, services, scheduled tasks, and startup entries.
backend/uninstall/uninstall-policy.json marks official uninstall and cleanup deletion as preview-only.

capabilities.notes: Backend protects WebView2 and shared runtimes in preview policy; no destructive removal path is live.

capabilities.title: Defender, SmartScreen, UAC, and security mitigation disable/removal
capabilities.summary: Optional playbook paths disable Defender, SmartScreen/UAC signals, security mitigations, Defender services, tasks, files, and cleanup launchers.
capabilities.notes: Security removal is intentionally not represented as an executable backend capability.

capabilities.title: Windows service and scheduled-task disable/delete matrix
capabilities.summary: Strip/harden/extended phases change 102 services and 7 scheduled tasks, including telemetry, printing, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Xbox, Defender, and update tasks.
capabilities.notes: No backend service mutation runner or service-state rollback exists outside cleanup preview metadata.

capabilities.title: Privacy, telemetry, cloud content, search, activity history, and policy registry hardening
capabilities.summary: Extended/privacy phases apply hundreds of HKLM/HKCU/HKU policy and settings registry values for telemetry, search, settings sync, app privacy, content delivery, and activity history.
sourceEvidence: fs-privacy option default true in playbook.conf
capabilities.notes: No registry backup/apply/rollback framework exists for these OS policy changes.

capabilities.title: Gaming registry/kernel/memory/graphics tweaks
capabilities.summary: Gaming phase changes graphics driver flags, SvcHost split threshold, service kill timeout, FTH, DisablePagingExecutive, GlobalTimerResolutionRequests, WER, GameDVR/Game Bar, scheduler, visual effects, and related settings.
sourceEvidence: phase4-gaming.yml statuses Applying Gaming Tweaks and Disabling WER
capabilities.notes: Likely relevant to stutter, but backend lacks registry snapshot, apply, reboot-gate, and validation evidence.

capabilities.title: Network adapter and USB device tuning
capabilities.summary: Gaming phase includes network adapter tuning and USB device tuning status blocks with PowerShell/registry actions.
sourceEvidence: phase4-gaming.yml statuses Tuning Network Adapters and Tuning USB Devices
capabilities.notes: Network/USB driver and adapter changes need hardware-aware backup and rollback before implementation.

capabilities.title: SetTimerResolution boot scheduled task
capabilities.summary: Playbook bundles SetTimerResolution.exe and setup-timerresolution.ps1 to create {source}-TimerResolution at boot using --resolution 5000 --no-console.
capabilities.notes: High relevance to latency/frame pacing, but no backend scheduled-task install, stop, rollback, or timer validation exists.

capabilities.title: Shell personalization, dark mode, wallpaper, taskbar/start cleanup, and context-menu tools
capabilities.summary: Apply phase configures wallpaper/lock screen/profile image, dark mode, transparency/animations, taskbar/start menu, classic context menu, safe-mode context menu, and drive tools.
capabilities.notes: Some context-menu actions are risky because they add elevated bcdedit/shutdown/defrag commands.

capabilities.title: Cross-device/Phone Link purge and known-folder restore cleanup
capabilities.summary: Playbook bundles crossdevice-neuter.ps1, crossdevice-purge.ps1, and R7-added restore-known-folders.ps1 for cross-device package/task removal and user shell-folder repair.
sourceEvidence: Executables/restore-known-folders.ps1 added in R7 vs R6.5
capabilities.notes: Removes packages, tasks, files, and registry keys; no backend rollback exists.

capabilities.title: Bundle and install Gaming toggles as a separate app
capabilities.summary: Apply phase copies {source}.exe into Program Files, creates a Public Desktop shortcut, and treats the bundled executable as an app separate from the playbook actions.
capabilities.notes: Catalog keeps Dash internals in backend/catalogs/gaming-toggles-capabilities.json, not in this playbook bucket.
